summary: "D3' locally closed carving (campaign :305). ADVANCED, NOT CLOSED. Owner\
  \ released.\n\nWHAT PIC-E LANDED (run 0095 r5, Picard/DivSupportQuasiFinite.lean,\
  \ 20 declarations, 0 sorries, rooted, lake build 8695 jobs EXIT=0, all axiom-clean\
  \ [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] vs fgaPicardRepresentability firing sorryAx).\n\
  \nTHE ROW'S BINDER IS REPRICED. Every theorem of Picard/DivPushforwardFlat.lean\
  \ carries LocallyQuasiFinite (schematicSupportI x.F followed by pullback.snd pi\
  \ T.hom), which that file calls producerless and not derivable from DivFamily's\
  \ other fields. All still true. What is new: the binder is EQUIVALENT to finiteness\
  \ of the fibres of D over T, because BOTH other binders mathlib's criteria want\
  \ (LocallyOfFiniteType, QuasiCompact) come from DivFamily.properSupport -- LocallyOfFiniteType\
  \ is a structure PARENT of IsProper, so it is a field access, not a search. At a\
  \ family the producer's hypothesis list is one item. Names: DivFamily.locallyQuasiFinite_iff_finite_fibers,\
  \ locallyQuasiFinite_iff_isFinite_fiber, locallyQuasiFinite_of_fibers, isFinite_support,\
  \ isFinite_support_of_fibers.\n\nTRAP for anyone consuming those theorems: HasProperSupport\
  \ is a def, NOT a class. 'haveI := hps' registers nothing and infer_instance fails\
  \ on both free binders. Cite the named theorems.\n\nWHAT REMAINS, and it is TWO\
  \ obligations not one -- corrected after a fresh-context audit refuted pic-e's own\
  \ 'nothing between the antecedent and finiteness is unbuilt':\n (a) THE GEOMETRY:\
  \ a nonempty effective Cartier divisor on a relative curve has finite fibres. On\
  \ C_t, D_t is the zero scheme of a regular section of an invertible ideal on a 1-dimensional\
  \ scheme. Untouched.\n (b) A CARRIER BRIDGE nobody had named: the fibrewise antecedent\
  \ quantifies over the FIBRE OF THE SUPPORT, while DivDegree.lean's fibre SES (fiberCokernelIso,\
  \ Scheme.DivFamily.isLocallyTrivial_fiber_kernel, mono_fiber_kernel_ii, fiberKernelIso)\
  \ is about the SUPPORT OF THE FIBRE. rfl FAILS between the carriers, and the bridge\
  \ is absent from the project: QuotSupportBaseChange.lean proves only annihilator\
  \ F <= (annihilator of the pullback).map, the direction giving properness of the\
  \ LARGER support. The reverse inclusion is what identifying the carriers needs.\n\
  \ (c) D3' PROPER, unchanged: the ExistsUnique statement about the Grassmannian locus.\
  \ Nothing above touches it. Also unchanged: the phi=id instance is not the antecedent\
  \ as a FAMILY over all test phi -- settle which D3' needs before pricing inputs\
  \ as done.\n\nDO NOT re-count the value. pic-e's commit messages claimed this retires\
  \ plumbing for THREE rows; that was withdrawn. D4' consumes D3' and never binds\
  \ LocallyQuasiFinite, so it was double-counted. HasLocallyConstantDivDeg (DivDegree.lean)\
  \ names TWO inputs -- the B3 rank half PLUS quasi-finiteness -- and this supplies\
  \ at most the second.\n\nDO NOT read the producer as content. DivFamily.locallyQuasiFinite_zero\
  \ discharges the binder at DivFamily.zero for arbitrary pi and T, but the empty\
  \ divisor is exactly where fibre finiteness is free, and MEASURED: with only the\
  \ pre-existing isEmpty_schematicSupport_of_isZero in scope, plain infer_instance\
  \ already closed both LocallyQuasiFinite and IsFinite there. It is satisfiability,\
  \ and the file adds a name rather than access.\n\nSTILL TRUE from the earlier row\
  \ text: DivFamily has exactly one producer in AJC (DivFamily.zero, Picard/DivFamilyZero.lean),\
  \ so every Cluster D' theorem is testable at one family only. NOTHING HERE CLOSES\
  \ THE SEAM SORRY; rep has no producer."

1	/-
     2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianClass
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivLocallyClosed
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The universal Grassmannian candidate for a divisor
    11	
    12	This file connects the D2 divisor-to-Grassmannian class to the D3
    13	curve-side candidate quotient.  It is kept downstream of both constructions
    14	so changes to this bridge do not force the large D2 development to recompile.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	namespace Scheme
    26	
    27	namespace DivFamily
    28	
    29	variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}
    30	
    31	/-- The reconstructed Grassmannian evaluation kills the relations of an
    32	actual divisor family.  The proof is the adjunction transpose of
    33	`kernel.ι (grassmannianEval L x) ≫ grassmannianEval L x = 0`; it uses no
    34	additional hypothesis beyond the data already needed to form that quotient. -/
    35	theorem grassmannianKernelEvaluation_comp_twistQuotientMap
    36	    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    37	    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    38	    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
    39	      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    40	    LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L
    41	        (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree) ≫
    42	      x.twistQuotientMap L = 0 := by
    43	  let q := x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree
    44	  change LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L q ≫
    45	    x.twistQuotientMap L = 0
    46	  apply ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    47	    (pullback.snd π T.hom)).homEquiv _ _).injective
    48	  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    49	  simp only [LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    50	  change (kernel.ι q.q ≫
    51	      pushforwardBaseChangeMap π T.hom (pullback.snd π T.hom)
    52	        (pullback.fst π T.hom) pullback.condition L) ≫
    53	      (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map
    54	        (x.twistQuotientMap L) = _
    55	  rw [Category.assoc]
    56	  change kernel.ι q.q ≫ q.q = _
    57	  rw [kernel.condition, Adjunction.homAddEquiv_zero]
    58	  rfl
    59	
    60	/-- The canonical comparison from the Grassmannian candidate cokernel to the
    61	twisted sheaf of an actual divisor family. -/
    62	noncomputable def grassmannianCandidateToTwist
    63	    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    64	    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    65	    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
    66	      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    67	    cokernel (LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L
    68	      (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree)) ⟶ x.twist L :=
    69	  cokernel.desc _ (x.twistQuotientMap L)
    70	    (grassmannianKernelEvaluation_comp_twistQuotientMap
    71	      L x hEpi hLocFree)
    72	
    73	/-- The candidate quotient followed by its comparison is the original
    74	twisted divisor quotient. -/
    75	theorem grassmannianCandidateQuotient_comp_candidateToTwist
    76	    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    77	    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    78	    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
    79	      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    80	    LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L
    81	        (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree) ≫
    82	      grassmannianCandidateToTwist L x hEpi hLocFree =
    83	        x.twistQuotientMap L :=
    84	  cokernel.π_desc _ _ _
    85	
    86	end DivFamily
    87	
    88	namespace Grassmannian
    89	
    90	variable {S X : Scheme.{0}} {π : X ⟶ S} [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    91	
    92	/-- The curve-side evaluation map attached to the universal quotient on the
    93	chosen scheme representing `Grassmannian (π_* L) d`. -/
    94	noncomputable def universalKernelEvaluation (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
    95	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
    96	      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    97	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :=
    98	  LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L
    99	    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)
   100	
   101	/-- The universal candidate quotient on
   102	`X ×_S representingScheme (Grassmannian (π_*L) d)`. -/
   103	noncomputable def universalCandidateQuotient (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
   104	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
   105	      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
   106	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :=
   107	  LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L
   108	    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)
   109	
   110	/-- The kernel of the universal candidate quotient.  This is the actual
   111	curve-side module whose invertible locus D3 must carve out; the kernel of the
   112	Grassmannian quotient itself lives on the base and has the wrong rank.  Its
   113	ordinary `lineBundleLocus` lies in the total space `X_G`; D3 must still descend
   114	the whole-fibre condition to a locus in the Grassmannian base `G`. -/
   115	noncomputable def universalCandidateIdeal (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
   116	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
   117	      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
   118	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :=
   119	  LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateIdeal L
   120	    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)
   121	
   122	/-- The universal candidate quotient is epimorphic by its cokernel
   123	construction. -/
   124	theorem universalCandidateQuotient_epi (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
   125	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
   126	      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
   127	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
   128	    Epi (universalCandidateQuotient L hV hd hdr) :=
   129	  LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient_epi L
   130	    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)
   131	
   132	end Grassmannian
   133	
   134	end Scheme
   135	
   136	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-
     2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivPushforwardFlat
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.AffineOpenStalkLocalization
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleCoherence
     9	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.QcohTildeSections
    10	
    11	/-!
    12	# The universal locally closed rank locus
    13	
    14	This file upgrades the matrix-defined flattening stratum from flatness to the
    15	rank-indexed local-freeness predicate used by the Grassmannian construction.
    16	In rank one it is therefore the universal locally closed locus on which the
    17	module becomes an invertible sheaf.
    18	
    19	The construction is unconditional.  It uses the existing presentation charts
    20	and their entry-ideal strata; it does not assume Picard representability or a
    21	rational point.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits
    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	namespace Scheme
    33	
    34	namespace Modules
    35	
    36	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    37	
    38	/-- An explicit rank-`e` basis of sections on an affine open trivialises the
    39	corresponding restriction of a quasi-coherent module. -/
    40	theorem pullback_isFreeOfRank_of_sectionsEquiv
    41	    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    42	    (e : ℕ) (E : (Fin e → Γ(X, U)) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(M, U)) :
    43	    Nonempty ((pullback U.ι).obj M ≅
    44	      SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin e))) := by
    45	  let N := (pullback hU.fromSpec).obj M
    46	  haveI : N.IsQuasicoherent := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom hU.fromSpec M inferInstance
    47	  haveI : IsIso (fromSpecRestrictTopHom M hU) :=
    48	    fromSpecRestrictTopHom_isIso M hU
    49	  haveI : IsIso ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback hU.fromSpec).hom.app M) := inferInstance
    50	  haveI : IsIso
    51	      (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback hU.fromSpec).hom.app M)) :=
    52	    inferInstance
    53	  let sectionHom : ModuleCat.of Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U) ⟶ moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N :=
    54	    fromSpecRestrictTopHom M hU ≫
    55	      moduleSpecΓFunctor.map ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback hU.fromSpec).hom.app M)
    56	  haveI : IsIso sectionHom := by
    57	    dsimp only [sectionHom]
    58	    exact IsIso.comp_isIso' (fromSpecRestrictTopHom_isIso M hU) inferInstance
    59	  haveI : IsIso N.fromTildeΓ := isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent N
    60	  let eIndex : (ULift.{u} (Fin e) →₀ Γ(X, U)) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] (Fin e → Γ(X, U)) :=
    61	    (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite Γ(X, U) Γ(X, U) (ULift.{u} (Fin e))).trans
    62	      (LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft Γ(X, U) Γ(X, U) Equiv.ulift.symm)
    63	  let eSections : (ULift.{u} (Fin e) →₀ Γ(X, U)) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)]
    64	      moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj N :=
    65	    eIndex.trans (E.trans (asIso sectionHom).toLinearEquiv)
    66	  let eSpec : N ≅
    67	      SheafOfModules.free (R := (Spec Γ(X, U)).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin e)) :=
    68	    qcoh_iso_tilde_sections N ≪≫
    69	      (tilde.functor Γ(X, U)).mapIso eSections.toModuleIso.symm ≪≫
    70	      tildeFinsupp (ULift.{u} (Fin e))
    71	  have hcomp : hU.isoSpec.hom ≫ hU.fromSpec = U.ι := by
    72	    rw [← hU.isoSpec_inv_ι, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    73	  exact ⟨
    74	    ((pullbackCongr hcomp).symm.app M) ≪≫
    75	      ((pullbackComp hU.isoSpec.hom hU.fromSpec).app M).symm ≪≫
    76	      (pullback hU.isoSpec.hom).mapIso eSpec ≪≫
    77	      pullbackFreeIso hU.isoSpec.hom (ULift.{u} (Fin e))⟩
    78	
    79	/-- The entry-ideal stratum is locally free of its prescribed rank.  This is
    80	the locally-free strengthening of `coherentSheafFlat_stratum`. -/
    81	theorem stratum_isLocallyFreeOfRank
    82	    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] {e : ℕ} (hcov : ChartsCover M e) :
    83	    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
    84	      ((pullback (stratumι M e hcov)).obj M) e := by
    85	  let N := (pullback (stratumι M e hcov)).obj M
    86	  haveI : N.IsQuasicoherent :=
    87	    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom (stratumι M e hcov) M inferInstance
    88	  let I := {V : X.affineOpens // IsPresentationChart M e V}
    89	  let W : I → (stratum M e hcov).Opens := fun j =>
    90	    stratumι M e hcov ⁻¹ᵁ j.1.1
    91	  refine ⟨I, W, ?_, fun j => ?_⟩
    92	  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    93	    intro z _
    94	    obtain ⟨V, hzV, hchart⟩ := hcov ((stratumι M e hcov).base z)
    95	    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨V, hchart⟩, hzV⟩
    96	  · obtain ⟨mm, ⟨P⟩⟩ := j.2
    97	    have hW : IsAffineOpen (W j) :=
    98	      j.1.2.preimage (stratumι M e hcov)
    99	    obtain ⟨P', hP'⟩ := exists_matrixPresentation_pullback_sections
   100	      (stratumι M e hcov) M j.1.2 hW le_rfl P
   101	    have h0 : P'.relMatrix = 0 := by
   102	      rw [hP']
   103	      ext a b
   104	      simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.zero_apply]
   105	      have hmem : ((stratumι M e hcov).app j.1.1).hom (P.relMatrix a b) = 0 := by
   106	        have hker : P.relMatrix a b ∈
   107	            RingHom.ker (((strataData M e hcov).subschemeι.app j.1.1).hom) := by
   108	          rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι_app]
   109	          change P.relMatrix a b ∈ strataIdeal M e j.1
   110	          rw [strataIdeal_eq_entryIdeal M P]
   111	          exact P.relMatrix_mem_entryIdeal a b
   112	        exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp hker
   113	      change ((stratumι M e hcov).appLE j.1.1 (W j) le_rfl).hom
   114	          (P.relMatrix a b) = 0
   115	      have happ : ((stratumι M e hcov).appLE j.1.1 (W j) le_rfl).hom
   116	          (P.relMatrix a b) =
   117	          ((stratum M e hcov).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_rfl).op).hom
   118	            (((stratumι M e hcov).app j.1.1).hom (P.relMatrix a b)) := rfl
   119	      rw [happ, hmem, map_zero]
   120	    exact pullback_isFreeOfRank_of_sectionsEquiv N hW e (P'.projEquiv h0)
   121	
   122	/-- Rank-indexed local freeness transports along an isomorphism of module
   123	sheaves, in arbitrary universe. -/
   124	theorem isLocallyFreeOfRank_of_iso_general {M N : X.Modules} (E : M ≅ N)
   125	    {e : ℕ} (hN : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank N e) :
   126	    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank M e := by
   127	  obtain ⟨I, U, hU, hfree⟩ := hN
   128	  exact ⟨I, U, hU, fun i => ⟨(pullback (U i).ι).mapIso E ≪≫ (hfree i).some⟩⟩
   129	
   130	/-- The canonical locally closed rank stratum carries a locally free module
   131	of exactly the indexed rank. -/
   132	theorem rankStratum_isLocallyFreeOfRank {S : Scheme.{u}}
   133	    (F : S.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (e : ℕ) :
   134	    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
   135	      ((pullback (rankStratumι F e)).obj F) e := by
   136	  let G := (pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F
   137	  haveI : G.IsQuasicoherent :=
   138	    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom (chartLocus F e).ι F inferInstance
   139	  let hcov : ChartsCover G e := chartsCover_chartLocus F e
   140	  have hfree := stratum_isLocallyFreeOfRank G hcov
   141	  let E : (pullback (rankStratumι F e)).obj F ≅
   142	      (pullback (stratumι G e hcov)).obj G :=
   143	    ((pullbackComp (stratumι G e hcov) (chartLocus F e).ι).app F).symm
   144	  exact isLocallyFreeOfRank_of_iso_general E hfree
   145	
   146	/-- The locally closed locus on which a module has rank one. -/
   147	noncomputable abbrev lineBundleLocus {S : Scheme.{u}} (F : S.Modules)
   148	    [F.IsQuasicoherent] : Scheme.{u} :=
   149	  rankStratum F 1
   150	
   151	/-- The immersion of the rank-one locus into its base. -/
   152	noncomputable abbrev lineBundleLocusι {S : Scheme.{u}} (F : S.Modules)
   153	    [F.IsQuasicoherent] : lineBundleLocus F ⟶ S :=
   154	  rankStratumι F 1
   155	
   156	instance {S : Scheme.{u}} (F : S.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
   157	    IsImmersion (lineBundleLocusι F) := inferInstance
   158	
   159	/-- The support of the rank-one locus is exactly the point-rank-one set. -/
   160	theorem mem_range_lineBundleLocusι_iff {S : Scheme.{u}}
   161	    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (s : S) :
   162	    s ∈ Set.range (lineBundleLocusι F).base ↔ pointRank S F s = 1 :=
   163	  mem_range_rankStratumι_iff F 1 s
   164	
   165	/-- On the rank-one locus the pulled-back module is an invertible sheaf. -/
   166	theorem lineBundleLocus_isLocallyTrivial {S : Scheme.{u}}
   167	    (F : S.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
   168	    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
   169	      ((pullback (lineBundleLocusι F)).obj F) := by
   170	  obtain ⟨I, U, hU, hfree⟩ := rankStratum_isLocallyFreeOfRank F 1
   171	  apply LineBundle.isLocallyTrivial_of_pointwise_free_one
   172	  intro x
   173	  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ i, U i := by rw [hU]; trivial
   174	  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
   175	  exact ⟨U i, hxi, hfree i⟩
   176	
   177	/-- A locally trivial line bundle is flat over its base.  This is the
   178	representation-facing form of the chart-local flatness recorded by
   179	`LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial`: on a trivialising affine chart its section
   180	module is linearly equivalent to the coordinate ring. -/
   181	theorem coherentSheafFlat_id_of_isLocallyTrivial {S : Scheme.{u}}
   182	    {F : S.Modules} (hF : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial F) :
   183	    Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 S) F := by
   184	  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF.isFinitePresentation
   185	  obtain ⟨I, U, hUaff, hUtop, hUiso⟩ := hF.exists_trivializing_cover
   186	  apply coherentSheafFlat_id_of_charts F U hUaff
   187	  · intro s

   204	    (hF : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial F) (s : S) :

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuasiProjectiveFiniteInAffine
import AlgebraicJacobian.Projective.Grassmannian

/-!
# Demand ledger for projective-morphism infrastructure

This file records the projective infrastructure demanded by the Picard
representability seam.  It is a ledger, not a second projectivity API.

## A seam-facing sufficient producer

`Scheme.PointedPicSharpRep` asks for a representing scheme that is locally of
finite type and satisfies `Scheme.FiniteInAffine`.  It does not ask for a line
bundle.  The existing project-local route supplies those two side conditions
from a coproduct of H-quasi-projective pieces:

* `Scheme.Hom.IsHQuasiProjective` is the universe-polymorphic embedding
  predicate from `Picard/ProjectiveMorphismBasic.lean`;
* `Scheme.locallyOfFiniteType_sigma` and
  `Scheme.finiteInAffine_over_sigma_of_isHQuasiProjective` aggregate the two
  side conditions in `Picard/QuasiProjectiveFiniteInAffine.lean`;
* at `Scheme.{0}`, `Scheme.Hom.IsHQuasiProjective.exists_isHQuasiProjectiveWith`
  adds a carried pullback of `O(1)`.  Thus the existing
  `IsHQuasiProjectiveWith` is already the required very-ample output; defining
  an alias named `IsVeryAmple` would only re-spell it.

A strong sufficient producer is recorded as
`pointedPicSharpQuasiProjectivePieces_demand`: if proved, it would construct the
representing coproduct and prove H-quasi-projectivity piecewise.  It is not the
minimal seam price: `HasGoodGaloisLevel` and `seamClauseOne` expose a weaker
single-finite-Galois-level route.  The two proved adapters below are only typing
and consumption checks.  They both assume `H`, whose closed proposition
packages the representation witness; they produce no representation and do not
reduce the current seam debt.  Their signatures add no explicit
`RepresentableBy` argument.

## The D4' Grassmannian demand

The committed divisor route has one narrower projective consumer before the
Picard-piece producer exists.  D3' must carve a scheme `Z` with a quasi-compact
immersion into the chosen scheme representing a Grassmannian over a field.  D4'
then needs `Z` to be H-quasi-projective so that its finite point sets lie in
affine opens.  The existing `IsHQuasiProjective.comp_isImmersion` performs the
last step. The field representer is now supplied directly by
`Scheme.Grassmannian.representingScheme_isHQuasiProjective_of_field`.

`Projective/Grassmannian.lean` proves the field-specialised transport: it derives
global freeness on `Spec K`, base-changes the absolute Grassmannian, and uses
uniqueness of representing objects. `Projective/GrassmannianProjective.lean`
now supplies the absolute certificate by the Plucker embedding. Properness of
the absolute Grassmannian is combined there with the proved immersion into
relative projective space; properness alone would not imply the project-local
definition of H-quasi-projectivity.

## No current section-Proj demand

Mathlib's `AlgebraicGeometry.Proj` is the Proj of an `N`-graded commutative
ring, not a relative Proj of a sheaf of graded algebras.  The project has enough
section-ring data to make that absolute Proj elaborate after two elementary
structure assemblies, but no Picard declaration consumes it: there is no
intrinsic `picSharpDeg` carrier, representing scheme for such a component, or
Picard-piece line bundle from which to form the section ring.  Consequently
those assemblies are not demands of the seam and are deliberately absent from
this ledger.

The live predecessor is the intrinsic degree and representation construction;
only that construction can expose a narrower Proj or ampleness signature.  A
general relative-Proj gluing theory or a general ample predicate must not be
built before then.  The whole Picard scheme must also not be strengthened to
`IsProjective`: its degree-graded coproduct is not quasi-compact, as recorded by
`Picard/AmbientPicNotProper.lean` and `Scheme.PointedPicSharpRepProjective`.

## Existing inputs

Curve projectivity is already produced by
`Adelic.isProjective_of_smoothProperGeometricallyIntegral`.  The carried
`O(1)`, base-change and open-image transport, `FiniteInAffine` transport, and
Over-coproduct assembly remain owned by the established Picard modules and are
imported here read-only.
-/

open CategoryTheory Limits

noncomputable section

universe u

namespace AlgebraicGeometry
namespace Scheme

/-- A sufficient projective presentation that the pointed Picard reduction can
consume at every universe: `picSharp` is represented by a coproduct of
H-quasi-projective schemes over the ground field.

The integer index records the intended degree pieces without introducing a
second, currently nonexistent `picSharpDeg` functor.  This closed proposition
contains the representation witness in its conclusion; no downstream theorem
takes an explicit representation-witness argument.  This keeps the strict
binder count unchanged, but it remains logically a representation assumption. -/
def PointedPicSharpQuasiProjectivePieces : Prop :=
  ∀ {K : Type u} [Field K] (E : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))),
    ∀ [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 E.hom] [IsProper E.hom]
      [GeometricallyIntegral E.hom],
      HasRationalPoint E →
        ∃ X : ℤ → Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)),
          Nonempty ((PicScheme.picSharp E).RepresentableBy (∐ X)) ∧
            ∀ d, (X d).hom.IsHQuasiProjective

/-- A piecewise H-quasi-projective representation supplies exactly the local
finite type and `FiniteInAffine` conjuncts of `PointedPicSharpRep`.

This is the seam-side typecheck for the ledger, not producer movement. -/
theorem pointedPicSharpRep_of_quasiProjectivePieces
    (H : PointedPicSharpQuasiProjectivePieces.{u}) :
    PointedPicSharpRep.{u} := by
  intro K _ E _ _ _ hpt
  obtain ⟨X, hrep, hX⟩ := H E hpt
  refine ⟨∐ X, hrep, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact locallyOfFiniteType_sigma X fun d => (hX d).locallyOfFiniteType
  · exact finiteInAffine_over_sigma_of_isHQuasiProjective X hX

/-- Conditional on the open ledger demand, the central seam follows verbatim,
with no rational point binder on the target theorem.  This adapter is not a
sorry-free producer or a discharge of the seam. -/
theorem fgaPicardRepresentability_of_quasiProjectivePieces
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (H : PointedPicSharpQuasiProjectivePieces.{u}) :
    (∃ X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)),
        Nonempty ((PicScheme.picEt C).RepresentableBy X) ∧
          LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom ∧ IsSeparated X.hom) ∧
      (HasRationalPoint C → IsIso (PicScheme.picEtComparison C)) :=
  fgaPicardRepresentability_of_pointedPicSharpRep C
    (pointedPicSharpRep_of_quasiProjectivePieces H)

/-- **Open sufficient producer.** Construct the pointed Picard representer as a
coproduct of H-quasi-projective pieces.  This is deliberately stronger than the
single-finite-Galois-level price of seam clause one. -/
theorem pointedPicSharpQuasiProjectivePieces_demand :
    PointedPicSharpQuasiProjectivePieces.{u} := by
  sorry

end Scheme

namespace Scheme
namespace Grassmannian

/-- A quasi-compact D3' immersion into an H-quasi-projective Grassmannian gives
the exact H-quasi-projectivity certificate carried by D4'.

This is a typing check for the demand above, not a construction of the missing
D3' locus or of the ambient Grassmannian certificate. -/
theorem d4Locus_isHQuasiProjective_over
    {S : Scheme.{0}} [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    {V : S.Modules} {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank V r)
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
    (Z : Over S)
    (j : Z ⟶ representingScheme hV hd hdr)
    [IsImmersion j.left] [QuasiCompact j.left]
    (hGr : (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom.IsHQuasiProjective) :
    Z.hom.IsHQuasiProjective := by
  rw [← j.w]
  exact hGr.comp_isImmersion j.left

end Grassmannian
end Scheme
end AlgebraicGeometry
